The check used grep -qi 'CUDA\|cuda\|GPU' (BRE); in this container's grep \| is not treated as alternation, so the pattern matches the literal string 'CUDA\|cuda\|GPU' rather than any of the three alternatives. Fix: grep -qiE 'CUDA|GPU' (extended regex, | is unambiguous alternation).
